title: Catalog controls
responsibility: Filters a catalog by search, changes, verification and shared usage.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.noun
inputs.description: Required lowercase plural entity name used in search labels and placeholder.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.filter
inputs.description: Bindable query, changed-only, verification, shared usage and ordering choices.

outputs.name: ExplorerControls
outputs.description: A local search field, changed-only switch, verification and usage filters, and ordering controls update the supplied filter. The host filters the rows.
